brief: The new infra stack for AI startups in 2026 — bye Heroku, hello Cloudflare.

slots.title: 1. Workers, the runtime
slots.body: Deploy globally in 300ms. Cloudflare Workers runs your inference at the edge, slashing latency and cost versus traditional containers.

slots.title: 2. Next.js, the framework
slots.body: The fullstack React framework for AI interfaces. Server Components stream LLM responses while Edge API routes handle auth and inference.

slots.title: 3. Supabase, the database
slots.body: Postgres with real-time subscriptions and vector support. Store user data and embeddings in one place without managing connection pools.

slots.title: 4. OpenAI, the engine
slots.body: GPT-4o and o1 series power core reasoning. Use structured outputs and streaming to build agents that actually complete tasks.

slots.title: 5. Redis, the cache
slots.body: Sub-millisecond caching for prompts and session state. Redis cuts LLM API costs and keeps user context hot between serverless invocations.

slots.title: 6. GitHub, the pipeline
slots.body: CI/CD and version control for AI products. GitHub Actions deploy to Cloudflare on every push with preview branches for testing.
